## Summary
Build a Supabase Realtime subscription hook that pushes live p_mastery updates to the mastery dashboard, so the radar chart and weak areas panel update in real-time as the student practices.

## User story
As a student, I want my mastery dashboard to update in real-time as I complete practice items, so that I see immediate feedback without needing to refresh the page.

## Why this matters
Without realtime updates, a student completing practice in one tab sees stale mastery data on their dashboard until they refresh. The instant feedback of watching mastery numbers rise is a powerful motivational signal.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] useMasteryRealtime hook subscribes to concept_mastery table changes for current student
- [ ] Subscription filters by student_id = auth.uid() (RLS enforced)
- [ ] Radar chart updates within 1 second of BKT write completing
- [ ] Weak areas panel reflects new p_mastery values live
- [ ] Subscription cleaned up in useEffect return function (Data Layer rule)
- [ ] Hook handles reconnection gracefully (Supabase Realtime auto-reconnects)
- [ ] No memory leaks: subscription unsubscribed on unmount
- [ ] Optimistic: shows updated value immediately, falls back to fetch on reconnect

## Canonical decisions in play
| Rule | What it means for this story |
|---|---|
| Data Layer | Clean up Realtime subscriptions in useEffect return function — MANDATORY |
| Data Layer | createBrowserClient() for Realtime subscription (anon key, RLS enforced) |
| RLS | Realtime subscription scoped to auth.uid() = student_id automatically |

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// features/mastery-tracking/hooks/useMasteryRealtime.ts
import { createBrowserClient } from '@journey/db/client';
import { useEffect, useCallback } from 'react';
import type { RealtimePostgresChangesPayload } from '@supabase/supabase-js';
import type { Row } from '@journey/db/client';

type ConceptMastery = Row<'concept_mastery'>;

export function useMasteryRealtime(
  studentId: string,
  onUpdate: (mastery: ConceptMastery) => void
) {
  const stableOnUpdate = useCallback(onUpdate, [onUpdate]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const supabase = createBrowserClient();

    const channel = supabase
      .channel(`mastery:${studentId}`)
      .on<ConceptMastery>(
        'postgres_changes',
        {
          event: '*',
          schema: 'public',
          table: 'concept_mastery',
          filter: `student_id=eq.${studentId}`,
        },
        (payload: RealtimePostgresChangesPayload<ConceptMastery>) => {
          if (payload.new && 'p_mastery' in payload.new) {
            stableOnUpdate(payload.new as ConceptMastery);
          }
        }
      )
      .subscribe();

    // MANDATORY: Clean up subscription on unmount (Data Layer rule)
    return () => {
      supabase.removeChannel(channel);
    };
  }, [studentId, stableOnUpdate]);
}
```

## Code patterns to AVOID
```typescript
// ✗ Missing cleanup — memory leak + stale subscriptions
useEffect(() => {
  const channel = supabase.channel('mastery').on(...).subscribe();
  // NO RETURN — subscription lives forever! BANNED
}, []);

// ✗ service_role key in browser
const supabase = createClient(url, SERVICE_ROLE_KEY); // FERPA violation — BANNED
// ✓ Use: createBrowserClient() (anon key, RLS enforced)

// ✗ No filter — receives ALL concept_mastery changes for all students
supabase.channel('mastery').on('postgres_changes', {
  event: '*',
  schema: 'public',
  table: 'concept_mastery',
  // Missing filter! BANNED — performance + privacy issue
})
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E08/E08-S08.ui.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';

test('Mastery dashboard updates in realtime after practice', async ({ page, context }) => {
  await loginAsStudent(page);
  await page.goto('/mastery');

  // Record initial mastery value
  const initialMastery = await page.locator('[data-testid="overall-mastery"]').textContent();

  // Open practice in new tab and complete an item
  const practicePage = await context.newPage();
  await loginAsStudent(practicePage);
  await practicePage.goto('/practice/quick-drill');
  await completePracticeItem(practicePage, true); // correct answer

  // Verify dashboard updated without refresh
  await page.waitForFunction(
    (initial) => {
      const current = document.querySelector('[data-testid="overall-mastery"]')?.textContent;
      return current !== initial;
    },
    initialMastery,
    { timeout: 5000 }
  );
});

test('Realtime subscription cleans up on navigation', async ({ page }) => {
  await loginAsStudent(page);
  await page.goto('/mastery');
  // Navigate away
  await page.goto('/dashboard');
  // No console errors about leaked subscriptions
  const errors = [];
  page.on('console', msg => {
    if (msg.type() === 'error') errors.push(msg.text());
  });
  await page.waitForTimeout(1000);
  const leakErrors = errors.filter(e => e.includes('subscription') || e.includes('channel'));
  expect(leakErrors.length).toBe(0);
});
```
